what: The rarest PS2 games by region, for the dashboard's Rarest page. Ranked by what collectors pay for a complete copy (PriceCharting's complete-in-box market price in US dollars, read on the date below), because no one counts how many copies exist: price is the measure of rarity collectors use. ebay_prices.py looks each game up once a day, the PAL list on eBay UK and the US list on eBay US.
method: Ranked by PriceCharting's complete-in-box (CIB) market price in USD for a used copy in that region, read on 2026-10-08 (prices drift by a few dollars between page loads). CIB is used because several PAL rarities have no loose price on PriceCharting, so it is the only figure every entry has. Candidates came from PriceCharting's console tables sorted by price (sort=highest-price, paged with &cursor=25/50/75/100/125/150/200). That sort is by loose price, so games with no loose price were added from collector articles and spot checks of individual game pages. Hardware, controllers, hardware/peripheral bundles (gun, guitar, dance mat, flightstick), not-for-resale/promo/demo discs, cheat discs, Linux kit and non-game discs are excluded. Greatest Hits, Platinum, Black Label and cover variants are folded into the base game. Special/limited/deluxe boxes and compilations sold under their own name are separate entries, as the brief allows. Collector articles (Racketboy 2022, GIGA 2026, Destructoid/CeX 2025, PPE.pl 2023/2024, whynow 2022, Retro Dodo 2020) are added as second evidence where they mention the game; their figures are quoted as stated. us_title/pal_title gives the other region's name where I know one; null means none known, not necessarily that none exists. value_usd repeats the PriceCharting figures used for ranking. ebay_search holds the words a listing title should contain. Generic words are flagged in notes; add 'ps2' to those searches.
gaps: Both lists reach 100, but the lower half is weaker than the top. (1) PriceCharting's price sort is by LOOSE price. Games with no loose price, or with a low loose and a high CIB price, only got in if an article named them or I spot-checked them. Sengoku Anthology, Gun Club, Ocean Commander, Raiden III, Iron Chef, Legend of Sayuki, Ar Tonelico 2 and Fire Pro Wrestling Returns came in that way, and similar PAL titles are probably still missing. Below roughly CIB $60 (PAL) and $90 (US), the order is not exhaustive. (2) Most entries have only one source: PriceCharting's USD market price, which for rare PAL games rests on a handful of sales. Entries flagged 'Weak' rest on one or two sales, or their CIB is several times their loose price. (3) White Van Racer, which the maintainer listed as a known rarity, is left out. PriceCharting gives loose $12.39 / CIB $22.36 (https://www.pricecharting.com/game/pal-playstation-2/white-van-racer, 2026-10-08), against Racketboy's $90–$180 in 2022, so its current value is unclear. Legend of Sayuki, Iron Chef and Hard Knock High are also lower on PriceCharting than in the 2022–2024 articles. (4) Cart Kings, Hanuman: The Boy Warrior and Ra One are Indian-market PAL releases, not Europe/UK/Australia; drop them if India should not count. (5) One PriceCharting page and one search returned HTTP 403 (rate limiting), so the Shin Megami Tensei: Lucifer's Call PAL figure was not obtained. (6) eBay 'sold' listings were not read directly; CeX prices (Destructoid) are UK shop prices, not private sales.

flags.weak: The guide value rests on one or two sales, or the complete price is several times the loose price.
flags.one_source: Only PriceCharting gives a figure for it.
flags.edition: A special edition or a compilation sold under its own name.
flags.india: Released for India, not Europe: rarely listed on eBay UK.
